description: Review finding CON-15: The epoch access proof is used outside envelopes (pin instructions, SFU admission) with no defined form (lens CON). Location: spec/05-messaging.md:368, :374; spec/10-relays.md:536; spec/06-calls.md:111; ARCHITECTURE.md:210-213. Fix: As the reviewer proposes. Define a typed `PinInstruction` (CIDs, `channelToken`, `epoch`, nonce/expiry) signed with the access key, plus its relay endpoint. Define SFU admission as a challenge signed with the access key, and state how the SFU learns the access public key. The SFU has no `AccessChainRegistration`, so it needs an `accessKeyAnnouncement` chain or must be a relay-registered party. Grep found no definition of either. Full text: notes/review/CON-verified.md and notes/review/CON.md.
close_reason: FIXED per notes/review/reconciliation.md: Typed PinInstruction (pin-op signed with admission key, nonce/expires) in spec/11-transport.md §11.4; SFU admission as challenge/join with admissionSig over sfu-admission, SFU learns key via AdmissionKeyRegistration (spec/06-calls.md §6.6 Admission; spec/10-relays.md §10.5.3)
